description:
Calculate a meal or recipe

The nutrients of a meal or recipe: `items` lists `<food>:<grams>` pairs, comma-separated (up to 30). A food is an id or a name (the best match is used and named in the answer, so check it); grams as `150`, `150g` or `1.5kg`. Answers each item's amounts and `meta.totals`; `meta.partial` lists nutrients some item had no value for (their totals add the known ones). Use when the user asks for the calories or macros of a dish, a recipe or a day's meals.

GET /v1/nutrition/calculate on Nutrition & Calories (SBX-BESIN). Costs 1 credit per call.
name: nutrition_calculateMeal
title: Nutrition & Calories: Calculate a meal or recipe
